name: Sahara Maritime Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, Sahara Maritime Ltd is in the business of providing Freight forwarding & Warehousing services.[1]
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1][2]
SML initially operated as a customs clearance broker. Gradually, it expanded across domains, geographies, and industries, and currently offers a comprehensive suite of logistics services for all maritime needs through a vast network of reliable partners and suppliers. The services include:
a) Core offerings:
- Transport management services.
- Freight-related services

pros: Stock is trading at 0.98 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 8.62% over last 3 years.
